dedupe_keys.name: hierarchical demand forecasting benchmark for the distribution grid rolle switzerland

description: This benchmark provides power measurements and weather forecasts from the distribution grid of Rolle, Switzerland, for evaluating demand forecasting algorithms for demand-side management. It was published by Lorenzo Nespoli, Vasco Medici, Kristijan Lopatichki and Fabrizio Sossan with an arXiv paper that tests several regressors for 24-hour-ahead load prediction. Measurements come from 62 IEC 61000-4-30 Class A power quality meters made by DEPsys, installed in secondary substations and low-voltage cabinets, with a set of 24 meters used for the benchmark, and the data are enriched with commercial numerical weather predictions. Coverage is the Rolle distribution grid, organised hierarchically from meters up to substations. Files are an HDF5 weather file and Python pickle files of power data, about 290 MB, on Zenodo (updated February 2021) under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost. Caveats: pickle files need Python to read and one small town may not represent other grids. Simulation uses are load forecasting and operation of distribution grids. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
